title: Yummy Jamaican Chuck Roast Stew
description: A winey, silky stew that brings nostalgic Jamaican flavors to your dinner table.
instructions: Heat olive oil over medium-high and brown the beef cubes until sealed.
Remove the beef, set aside, and in the same pan cook onions and garlic until softened.
Stir in thyme, allspice, and scotch bonnet pepper, cooking for 1 minute to release aromas.
Deglaze with red wine, scraping up browned bits, and reduce by half.
Return the beef to the pan, pour in beef broth, and bring to a gentle boil.
Simmer uncovered for 90 minutes, then blanch the carrots in boiling water for 3 minutes, drain, and add them to the stew.
Cook for an additional 15 minutes, or until the carrots are tender.
Remove from heat, season to taste, and serve warm over rice or with crackers.
